description.en: Connect a Codex local/programmatic workflow token and optional Codex App Server endpoint.
description.ja: Codex local/programmatic workflow token と任意の Codex App Server endpoint を接続します。

displayName.en: ChatGPT account via Codex App Server
displayName.ja: Codex App Server 経由の ChatGPT account

description.en: Read the signed-in Codex App Server account without storing a Rumi Platform API key.
description.ja: Rumi Platform API key を保存せず、Codex App Server にサインイン済みの account を読み取ります。

description.en: Optional local/programmatic workflow token stored separately from Codex App Server auth.
description.ja: Codex App Server auth とは別に保存する任意の local/programmatic workflow token です。

description.en: Optional WS token or shared secret for non-loopback App Server endpoints.
description.ja: non-loopback App Server endpoint 用の任意の WS token / shared secret です。

description.en: Store a Codex access token for local and programmatic workflow integrations. The token is not used for Codex App Server auth.
description.ja: local/programmatic workflow 用の Codex access token を保存します。この token は Codex App Server auth には使いません。

description.en: Use Codex App Server as a Tools & MCP tool source and automation endpoint with separate App Server auth.
description.ja: Codex App Server を別の App Server auth で Tools & MCP の tool source / automation endpoint として使います。

description.en: Start a Codex thread through a local or App Server-backed transport.
description.ja: local または App Server-backed transport で Codex thread を開始します。

description.en: Run a Codex turn against a configured thread.
description.ja: configured thread に対して Codex turn を実行します。

description.en: Read event streams from a Codex session without granting approvals by itself.
description.ja: approval 付与なしで Codex session の event stream を読み取ります。

description.en: Approve or deny high-impact Codex actions such as writes, terminal commands, and git operations.
description.ja: write、terminal command、git operation など high-impact Codex action を approve / deny します。

description.en: Run Codex-backed execution that can reach workspace, terminal, or git operations under approval policy.
description.ja: approval policy の下で workspace、terminal、git operation に到達し得る Codex-backed execution を実行します。

metadata.secret_handling: Never expose the raw Codex token or Codex App Server secret in Settings payloads, logs, snapshots, repository files, or CLI arguments.
